page.overview:
Who is Quan Chi?

Quan Chi (Chinese: 拳痴) is a character in the Mortal Kombat series. A demon of the Netherrealm known for his dark magic and necromancy, Quan Chi is a powerful enemy to both Earthrealm and Outworld, and a major ally to the Fallen Elder God Shinnok. He often serves as the secondary antagonist of the franchise alongside Shang Tsung, forming what is known as The Deadly Alliance.

Quan Chi made his debut in the animated series, Mortal Kombat: Defenders of the Realm while his first video game appearance was in Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero in which he served as a secondary antagonist and sub-boss, a role he reprises in many games after. He serves as the titular antagonist of Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance alongside Shang Tsung.

Quan Chi made his playable debut in Mortal Kombat 4 in which he served as the secondary antagonist. Quan Chi would return in Mortal Kombat (2011), serving as one of the two main antagonists alongside Shao Kahn. He returns in Mortal Kombat X, once again serving as one of two main antagonist of the game's Story Mode alongside Shinnok.

A new version of Quan Chi appears in Mortal Kombat 1 as a secondary antagonist in the game's Story Mode alongside a new version of Shang Tsung before becoming playable through DLC as the second character available in the Kombat Pack.
